caseName: Lush v. Commissioner of Education of New York
caseNameFull: Reginald Lush v. Commissioner of Education of New York
attorneys: Francis G. Hessney for appellant., Charles A. Brind for appellee., Max G. Morris for Board of Education Central School District No. 1, intervenor-appellee.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The motions to dismiss are granted and the appeal is dismissed. Treating the papers whereon the appeal was taken as a petition for writ of certiorari, certiorari is denied.
